name: @omadia/transcription-api
description: The versioned, SDK-free transcription CONTRACT for the omadia middleware. Holds only the `transcription@1` capability constant, the TranscriptionService interface, the neutral audio/option DTOs (AudioFile, AudioFormat, TranscribeOptions), the result types (Transcript, TranscriptSegment, TranscriptDelta, TimingProvenance, TranscriptionUsage), and the TranscriptionError class. Zero runtime dependencies — this is the public surface a transcription adapter package compiles against. See byte5ai/omadia#584.
